notes: 19,807 is a per-allele sweep latency (M-601); dividing a window by it gives one fixation per latency, so the six/seven figure carries width 1 whatever the division is called. Day's 'adjusted for parallelism' names no width factor in this figure; the Bernoulli paper's (300,000/440) x 230 shows what one looks like. The 1,600 and 1,322 gen/fix are LTEE throughputs (counts over a window), so '19,800 > 1,600' compares a latency with a throughput. The 6.3 and 7.4 inputs are the claim file's reconstruction; Day prints neither the window nor the quotient, and the parameters.yaml values carry verified: false.
